# sh-fpv-photo-album-stack

**Purpose:** The stack of her photos inside Widget / Photo Album. Count = how many photos the stack shows: 1, 2, 3 or 4. 4+ = four photos plus the "+N" badge on the last one, where N = her album count minus 4 (e.g. 8 more photos → "+4"). Blurred = the four photos blurred; not used on any screen on this page.

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 6 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2877-20760) (node `2877:20760`)
